changelog: Doppelgangers now keep the full copied stat block of whatever they cloned, carrying it across every battle for the rest of the run. Forward Outpost can be raised on any visible, empty tile instead of only next to your base, and Scout Ahead now grants a unit extra sight for the turn rather than a wide reveal. Nomad's Mobilize correctly targets your buildings, and cards that need another commander's power charge (like ones the Alchemist scrambles into your hand) can no longer be forced. The attack kill-marker now accounts for a target's shields, and Hold-the-Position / Survive missions field more enemies in the later acts. Earned medals now sit in a clean row just under the top bar.
